items.title: Andhra Pradesh SEC warns public against fake election schedules
items.desc: Andhra Pradesh SEC warns against fake local body election schedules on social media; says no dates set yet and threatens cyber law action for misinformation.

items.title: Long-standing conflict between Assam, Meghalaya cabbies boils over
items.desc: Assam-Meghalaya taxi dispute escalates: repeated stand-offs since 2024 over tourist traffic, alleged harassment; border blockades at Jorabat after Aug 19 violence.

items.title: Minister seeks action against DMK MLA over remarks against Vijay
items.desc: Tamil Nadu Assembly row: Minister Vijayalakshmi seeks action against DMK MLA Durai Chandrasekaran over remarks on CM Vijay; Speaker to review privilege breach.

items.title: Govt may raise Aavin milk procurement price to ₹44
items.desc: Tamil Nadu govt may hike Aavin milk procurement price to Rs 44/litre from Rs 41 amid farmer demands, with talks planned to address rising input costs.

items.title: 20 Jharkhand children sent to Kochi for free heart surgery
items.desc: Jharkhand Health Department sends 20 children with congenital heart defects to Amrita Hospital, Kochi for free surgery, care, travel and follow-ups under RBSK.

items.title: Fake food safety officer threatens hotel staff, demands money
items.desc: Fake Food Safety Officer threatened a Mylavaram hotel, demanded money; police used Suraksha 360 CCTV to trace car, found pistol-like lighter, suspect identified.

items.title: Gospadu police arrest inter-district burglary gang, recover Rs 27 lakh jewellery
items.desc: Nandyal police arrested a three-member burglary gang and recovered ₹27 lakh worth of stolen jewellery, in connection with recent theft cases in the district.

items.title: RTC JAC urges govt to end promotion freeze
items.desc: APSRTC Employees Union JAC urges Andhra Pradesh govt to lift promotion freeze, citing delays for 3,000 staff and risks for 500 retirees this month.

items.title: Police register case against private hospital, 9 doctors over woman’s death
items.desc: Vijayawada police book nine doctors and Svara Super Specialty Hospital after court order over 51-year-old woman’s death; FIR alleges negligence, forgery, conspiracy.

items.title: HC tells officials to comply with statutory requirements on temple land lease for data centre
items.desc: Andhra Pradesh HC cautions officials on Simhachalam temple land lease for hyperscale data centre, stressing statutory compliance and environmental clearances amid PIL.

items.title: HC directs govt to safeguard emergency services amid junior doctors’ strike
items.desc: Andhra Pradesh High Court seeks state report on steps to protect emergency services and end junior doctors’ strike, after PIL cites delays in govt hospitals.

items.title: 'NAZA,' an Israeli documentary about Israel's actions in Gaza, to premiere at Venice Film Festival
items.desc: Directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, 'NAZA,' which derives its name from the Hebrew military acronym for collateral damage, is billed as showing 'in detail the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza'

items.title: Vizag UKG student death: Police alter case to culpable homicide, book teacher
items.desc: Vizag UKG student death: Police add JJ Act Section 75 and BNS Section 105, changing case to culpable homicide; teacher may face arrest after slap incident.

items.title: Cooperstown Notebook: A Rough Year for Giancarlo Stanton and Other Hall of Fame Hopefuls
items.desc: In the first of two installments, here's a look at some veterans whose progress towards a spot in the Hall of Fame has hit a few bumps in 2026.

items.title: 72,338 in-service teachers to take special TET
items.desc: Andhra Pradesh Special TET announced for 72,338 in-service teachers; online applications Aug 25–Sep 24, CBT exams Oct 11–21, results Nov 15.

items.title: HC to hear PIL challenging BC quota restoration in local bodies
items.desc: PIL in Andhra Pradesh High Court challenges restoration of 34% BC quota in panchayats and 33.33% in urban bodies, citing 50% reservation cap violations.

items.title: Know a ganja peddler? Spill the weed trail, earn ₹5,000
items.desc: Vijayawada police and Andhra Pradesh EAGLE offer ₹5,000 for tips leading to ganja trafficker arrests and ₹1,500 for user identification amid crackdown and outreach.

items.title: Minister honours Vizianagaram’s award-winning teacher
items.desc: State minister Kondapalli Srinivas felicitated Vizianagaram teacher Kouluri Rajesh for winning the national best teacher award for tech-driven education initiatives.
